content:
kamal: Canary on /v1/embeddings just spiked — p95 went from ~120ms to ~900ms at 11:12 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/embeds/summary. Deploy was 4m ago (rev=release-2.4.1). Do we pin, rollback, or route around?

deploybot: deploybot: Alert: p95 900ms (>500ms threshold). Autorevert configured but currently suppressed (maintenance window). Suggested actions: manual pin to a prior version or trigger rollback.

nora: oncall: digging in. Early signs: KV cache miss rate up, batch sizes jumped for one customer. Could be long-sequence storm rather than model regression.

aj: if it's KV miss storm, fallback to 2.4.0 has historically avoided the new kv-cache change. Can we split traffic to test?

sophie: we can do a targeted split. Example: `redwood route update embeddings --split 95:release-2.4.1,5:release-2.4.0` — runs in <30s.

ops-lead: prefer pin+notify first. If metrics not recovered in 10m we'll escalate to full rollback. @kamal you have authority to pin?

kamal: doing a safety pin for a small slice now. Command: `redwood pin set --route embeddings --version release-2.4.0 --duration 1h`

deploybot: deploybot: Pin applied by kamal at 2026-03-10T11:18:23Z. Traffic split now 95/5 (2.4.1/2.4.0). Observing metrics.

nora: pinned slice p95 ~160ms already. Looks like the older version avoids the regression. :thumbsup:

emily: can we get a short blurb for support & customers? I'll draft release-note style copy.

aj: also open a rollback ticket and capture why we pinned (KV-cache heuristic + batch spike).

kamal: created ticket INF-1234: "embeddings p95 spike — staged pin to 2.4.0" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234. Adding logs and tracer links.

sophie: note for follow-up: add kernel flag check and quantization path toggles in the postmortem. Small code snippet I ran locally: ```kubectl logs -n inference -l svc=embeddings | grep KVCACHE```

ops-lead: plan: keep staged pin until 18:00 UTC, monitor. If no regressions, we will schedule a controlled rollback window at 00:30 UTC to roll everyone back to 2.4.0, then create a proper release with the kv-cache fix. Notify sales/support now.

emily: drafting customer note now — short, no deep tech. "We temporarily routed a portion of traffic to a prior model version to reduce latency for some API requests. No data exposure. We'll follow up with details once we complete the investigation."

deploybot: deploybot: Autorevert suppression cleared at 2026-03-10T12:05:00Z. No auto-revert executed because manual pin present.

kamal: good catch everyone. Will keep this thread updated. Closing action: retain pin, notify stakeholders, prepare rollback window if needed.

emily: sending support+sales note in 5.

sophie: leaving a short runbook entry in the ticket with the split commands and rollback steps.

kamal: thanks — marking this as active until INF-1234 is resolved.
